events.title: Bad Vilbeler Quellenlauf
events.description: Bad Vilbel's traditional running event through the spa town and along the Nidda, with 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon routes plus school and family runs. Start and finish at the Kurpark; registration on the day usually possible.

events.title: Herborner Kartoffel-Sonntag
events.description: A relaxed harvest Sunday in Herborn's old town celebrating the potato: roasted potatoes, potato pancakes, potato soup and regional specialities, accompanied by a small farmers' market and live folk music. Shops in the historic centre are open.

events.title: Tag des offenen Denkmals Idstein - Turm- und Schlossführungen
events.description: Germany's nationwide Heritage Open Day, marked in Idstein with guided tours of the Hexenturm and the historic Residenzschloss, plus free access to the town's medieval centre. Experts explain restoration work on the 17th-century painted castle chapel.
events.cost_per_person: Free (some tours require a small fee)

events.title: Usinger Laurentius Markt (Laurentiuskerb)
events.description: Usingen's big traditional fair around St Lawrence, with a Krammarkt, funfair rides, food stalls and live music on the Marktplatz. The 2026 edition runs 11-14 September, closing with a Sunday parade through the old town.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry, ride/food prices on site

events.title: Eröffnung der Sonderausstellung 'BLACKBOX Heimerziehung' mit Filmvorführung
events.description: Opening of the touring exhibition on the history of West German children's homes, followed by a documentary screening and discussion with contemporary witnesses. Organised in Gießen by the city's cultural office as part of the Liebknecht 200 programme.

events.title: Großenritter Zeltkirmes Baunatal
events.description: Baunatal-Großenritte's four-day tent fair (17-20 September) with a big marquee, beer wagons, fairground rides and live bands, culminating in a Kirmes parade on Sunday. A classic north Hessian Dorfkirmes with a strong local tradition.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry to grounds, pay per ride

events.title: Bessunger Kerb Darmstadt
events.description: Darmstadt-Bessungen's neighbourhood parish fair, running 17-21 September with fairground rides, Kerbeborsch stands, brass music and the traditional Kerbebaum raising. One of the liveliest of Darmstadt's many Kerben.

events.title: Friedberger Herbstmarkt
events.description: The Wetterau's largest fair (18-22 September) fills Friedberg's Kaiserstraße and Stadtkirche square with around 200 traders, a big funfair, a Krammarkt and a dedicated fashion and homewares section. Live music every evening and a fireworks finale.

events.title: Groß-Gerauer Street Food Festival
events.description: Around 25 food trucks and street-food stands from across Europe park up in Groß-Gerau's Stadtpark for three days (18-20 September), with DJ sets, craft beer and a children's area. Free entry, pay per dish.

events.title: Umstädter Winzerfest
events.description: Groß-Umstadt's vintners' festival (18-21 September) celebrates the small but distinctive Odenwald wine region with tastings from local estates, a wine queen, brass bands and the traditional Fassanstich on the Marktplatz.

events.title: Niederzwehrener Märchentage
events.description: Kassel's ten-day fairy-tale festival in the Niederzwehren district (18-27 September): theatre for children, puppet shows, readings from the Brothers Grimm, a masked parade and a fairy-tale market. A core part of Kassel's Grimm heritage programming.
events.cost_per_person: Most events free, some performances ticketed

events.title: Marburger Weinboulevard
events.description: Wine stands along the Oberstadt and Marktplatz bring around 20 German and international wineries to Marburg's old town, with regional food, live music on several small stages and sweeping views over the Lahn valley.

events.title: Medenbacher Kerb
events.description: Neighbourhood parish fair in Wiesbaden-Medenbach (18-20 September) with rides, a Kerbestand, handcart races and the traditional Kerbebaum. Sunday features an ecumenical service followed by a parade.

events.title: Delkenheimer Kerb
events.description: Wiesbaden-Delkenheim's village fair (18-20 September), one of the capital's most popular Kerben, with a fairground, Apfelwein stands, live bands and the traditional Kerbepaar. Free entry across the weekend.

events.title: Lorscher Kerb mit Tabakfest
events.description: Lorsch's combined parish fair and tobacco festival (19-21 September) recalls the town's once-thriving tobacco industry with a tobacco-leaf parade, historic machinery demonstrations, a fairground and wine and beer stands in the old town.

events.title: Taste of Korea Neu-Isenburg
events.description: A one-day Korean food and culture festival in Neu-Isenburg with street-food stalls (bibimbap, tteokbokki, Korean fried chicken), K-pop dance performances, calligraphy workshops and a hanbok photo corner. Organised with the town's Korean community.

events.title: Haßlocher Eppelwoifest
events.description: Rüsselsheim-Haßloch's apple-wine festival (19-20 September), staged by local clubs around the historic Haßlocher Rathaus, with Ebbelwoi from regional press houses, handkäse, music and a Sunday morning Frühschoppen.

events.title: 23. Freudenberger Oktoberfest
events.description: Wiesbaden-Freudenberg's Wiesn night on the Festplatz, now in its 23rd year: Bavarian beer tent, brass and party bands (2026: Die Grummis), dirndl and lederhosen dress code, and a full evening of Wiesn party atmosphere from 17:00.

events.title: Herbstzauber im Botanischen Garten Eschwege
events.description: Eschwege's autumn garden market in the Botanical Garden: nursery plants, bulbs, regional honey and preserves, garden art, coffee and cake, plus guided tours of the late-summer borders. A gentle, family-friendly Sunday event.
events.location: Botanischer Garten Eschwege, Am Botanischen Garten, 37269 Eschwege

events.title: Herbst- und Bauernmarkt Hann. Münden
events.description: A regional farmers' and autumn market in Hann. Münden's half-timbered old town, with producers from the Werra and Fulda valleys selling apples, pumpkins, cheese, sausage and cider. Cooking demonstrations and a children's hay-bale play area.

events.title: Kassel Marathon
events.description: The 20th edition of northern Hesse's biggest running event: marathon, half-marathon, relay, 10 km and a children's run, all finishing in the Auestadion after a flat, fast course through the Karlsaue and along the Fulda. Anniversary edition with a large finish-line festival.

events.title: Bürgeler Markt Offenbach
events.description: Offenbach-Bürgel's traditional autumn market on the historic Marktplatz, with around 80 traders offering crafts, household goods, textiles and regional produce, plus a small funfair and organ-grinder music. One of the city's oldest market traditions.

events.title: Matinée musicale der Hempelstiftung
events.description: A morning chamber concert in the Loge Plato on Wiesbaden's Friedrichstraße, given by young prizewinning musicians supported by the Hempelstiftung. Programme mixes classical sonatas with contemporary chamber works; coffee afterwards.
events.location: Loge Plato, Großer Saal, Friedrichstraße 35, 65185 Wiesbaden

events.title: Eltviller Street Food Festival
events.description: Street-food trucks from across Europe set up along the Rhine promenade in Eltville for three days (25-27 September), paired with Rheingau wine and Sekt stands, lounge music and sunset views over the river.
events.location: Rheinufer / Kurfürstliche Burg, 65343 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Kerb Wildsachsen
events.description: Hofheim-Wildsachsen's village fair (25-28 September) with rides, food and drink stands and the traditional Kerbebaum setting. Sunday morning Frühmesse followed by a parade through the village.

events.title: Weiten-Gesäßer Kerb
events.description: Michelstadt-Weiten-Gesäß's Odenwald parish fair (25-28 September) with a Kerbebaum, fairground rides, a lively Kerbedisco and the traditional Sunday Kerbezug. Strongly rooted in the village's club life.

events.title: Bauschemer Kerb
events.description: Rüsselsheim-Bauschheim's parish fair (25-28 September), one of the largest in the Rüsselsheim area, with a big fairground, Kerbehalle, brass music and the Sunday Kerbeumzug. Add a separate Nachkerb the following weekend.

events.title: Wiesbadener Stadtfest mit Herbstmarkt und Kunsthandwerkermarkt
events.description: Wiesbaden's big city festival (25-27 September) across the Innenstadt, Altstadt, Warmer Damm, Fußgängerzone and Mauritiusplatz: a rotating stage programme, the Herbstmarkt and Kunsthandwerkermarkt, the Erntedankfest, a classic-car show on Schlossplatz and a Sunday shopping day.

events.title: Erbenheimer Kerb
events.description: Wiesbaden-Erbenheim's parish fair (25-27 September) with a funfair, Kerbebaum, Bratwurst and Apfelwein stands, and the Kerbeborsch procession on Sunday. Live music in the Kerbezelt on all three days.

events.title: Zauberhafte LichterNacht Alsfeld
events.description: Alsfeld's old town is lit by thousands of candles, torches and light installations for one evening, with open shops and courtyards, street musicians, fire artists and regional food stands between the half-timbered houses.

events.title: IGO Herbstmarkt Bad Homburg
events.description: The Interessengemeinschaft Ober-Erlenbach's autumn market in Bad Homburg-Ober-Erlenbach, with regional producers, handicraft stalls, pumpkin displays and a small harvest stage programme. Shops and courtyard cafés open alongside.
events.location: Ober-Erlenbach Ortsmitte, 61352 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Gießener Herbstmesse
events.description: Central Hesse's biggest autumn fair (26 September - 4 October), filling the Gießen fairground with more than 100 showmen's businesses, a large Krämermarkt, a beer tent with live music and the traditional Sunday parade. Nine days of rides, food and market stalls.

events.title: 2. Kasseler Oktoberfest
events.description: Kassel's second Oktoberfest in the Ernst-Freudental-Halle (Messe Kassel): Bavarian beer, brass-band entertainment, a Wiesn host, dirndl and lederhosen encouraged and a full party programme into the night.

events.title: Reckenforst Hüttengaudi Limburg
events.description: An Alpine-themed party night at Limburg's Reckenforst venue, with DJs, bar huts, beer-bench seating and party hits until late. The 2026 edition opens Limburg's autumn event season.
events.location: Reckenforst, Limburg an der Lahn, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Erntedankfest am Warmen Damm
events.description: Wiesbaden's harvest-thanksgiving festival in the green space on the Warmer Damm (26-27 September): around 40 market stalls from Hessian farms and growers, an ornamental-gourd display, rural craft demonstrations and a small stage with brass and folk music.

events.title: Wurschtfest Eschwege
events.description: Eschwege's cheerful sausage festival in the old town, with around 20 local butchers and food stands grilling, boiling and smoking their best sausages, plus beer, brass music and a children's programme on the Marktplatz.

events.title: Rheingau Literatur Preis 2026 - Preisverleihung
events.description: Lukas Rietzschel receives the Rheingau Literatur Preis 2026 for his novel 'Sanditz' at Schloss Johannisberg, in a ceremony with a reading and laudation, framed by Rheingau Musik Festival performers. One of the region's most prestigious literary awards.

events.title: Interkulturelle Woche Heppenheim
events.description: Heppenheim's intercultural week (27 September - 4 October) opens with an international street festival in the old town: food from a dozen cuisines, music and dance from migrant communities, a bazaar and a children's programme.

events.title: Öffentlicher Rundgang: Charles Ray im Fridericianum
events.description: A guided public walk-through of the Charles Ray exhibition at the Fridericianum with the museum's mediators, exploring the American sculptor's monumental, unsettling figures and their dialogue with the building's documenta history.

events.title: Lorscher Kelterfest
events.description: A hands-on wine-pressing festival by the UNESCO World Heritage Lorsch Abbey: visitors help press grapes in a historic wooden press, taste fresh Federweißer and must, and tour the abbey's wine cellars. Regional food and live music all afternoon.

events.title: Michaelismarkt Melsungen
events.description: Melsungen's historic Michaelismarkt fills the narrow old town and the Bartenwetzer bridge area with market stalls, sweet stalls, pottery and cloth traders, plus brass music and a Punch-and-Judy show for children. Held since the 16th century.

events.title: Verkaufsoffener Rieslingsonntag Rüsselsheim
events.description: Rüsselsheim's wine-themed Sunday shopping day: shops open through the afternoon while Rheingau and Rheinhessen wineries pour Riesling at stands along the Fußgängerzone, with live music and a children's programme.
events.location: Innenstadt Rüsselsheim, Marktplatz, 65428 Rüsselsheim am Main

events.title: Rimbacher Kartoffelfest
events.description: Schlitz-Rimbach's potato festival in the Vogelsberg village, with potato dishes of every kind, a potato-sack race, handcart parade and rural craft demonstrations. A genuine, unhurried village harvest festival.

events.title: Eröffnung: Studioausstellung im documenta archiv
events.description: Opening of the studio exhibition 'Zwischen Akten, Fotografien und Leinwand - Einblicke in die Restaurierung' at the documenta archiv, showing how conservators treat photographs, papers and canvases from the documenta holdings. Curators introduce the project.

events.title: Dr. Cordelia Schott: Rezeptfrei
events.description: The physician and comedian dissects Germany's pharmacy counter and self-medication culture with medical accuracy and dry humour, live in the Centralstation Darmstadt.

events.title: Tobias Mann - Real/Fake
events.description: Cabaret in the atmospheric Brentanoscheune at Oestrich-Winkel: Tobias Mann interrogates truth, fake news and self-deception with sharp political satire and piano accompaniment, in a Rheingauer Wein Bühne production.

events.title: PAUL PANZER - Schöne neue Welt
events.description: The Hessian comedian's new arena show in the Buderus Arena Wetzlar: a fast-paced, opinionated take on digital life, AI and everyday absurdity, with live band and large video staging.

events.title: 21. Allergiekongress 2026
events.description: Germany's principal three-day allergy congress (1-3 October) at the RheinMain CongressCenter, with scientific sessions, an industry exhibition and training courses for allergologists, dermatologists and paediatricians.

events.title: Bad Nauheimer Kerb
events.description: Bad Nauheim's parish fair (2-6 October) around the Kerbeborsch tradition, with a fairground in the Kurstraße area, Kerbezelt with live bands, Bratwurst and apple-wine stands, and the traditional Kerbeumzug on the Sunday.

events.title: Internationales Gitarrenfestival Bad Wildungen
events.description: A three-week guitar festival (2-25 October) bringing international classical and flamenco guitarists to Bad Wildungen's spa architecture, with concerts, masterclasses and a young talent competition. Concerts mostly weekend evenings.
events.location: Kurhaus Bad Wildungen, Brunnenallee 1, 34537 Bad Wildungen

events.title: 'Drachen. Mythos und Wirklichkeit' - Sonderausstellung
events.description: Opening of the Hessisches Landesmuseum Darmstadt's major special exhibition on dragons (from 2 October), spanning myth, natural history and popular culture, with Chinese dragon processions, medieval bestiaries, fossils and fantasy film props.

events.title: Ray Wilson: The Weight Of Man
events.description: The former Genesis and Stiltskin frontman plays the Stadthalle Friedberg with a band set covering his solo catalogue plus Genesis and Stiltskin classics, including 'The Weight of Man' material.

events.title: Gießener Krämermarkt
events.description: A classic three-day Krämermarkt (2-4 October) on Gießen's Brandplatz and Marktplatz, running in parallel with the Herbstmesse: textiles, kitchenware, sweets, spices and household goods from around 80 travelling traders.

events.title: Langenhainer Kerb
events.description: Hofheim-Langenhain's parish fair (2-5 October) with rides, Kerbestand, apple wine and the Langenhainer Kerbepaar. Sunday parade and open-air Frühschoppen.

events.title: Eröffnung: Mohammed Sami - Hostless
events.description: Opening of the solo exhibition by Iraqi-Swedish painter Mohammed Sami at the Fridericianum, with a children's vernissage earlier the same afternoon. Sami's large canvases address memory, displacement and domestic space.

events.title: Michelstädter Weinbrunnenfest
events.description: Michelstadt's Odenwald wine festival (2-4 October) around the historic Marktbrunnen, with regional Odenwald and Bergstrasse wines, a wine queen, brass music and guided tastings in the town's vaulted cellars.

events.title: Hesslocher Kuckuckskerb
events.description: Wiesbaden-Kohlheck/Hessloch's quirky 'Cuckoo Kerb' (2-4 October), named for the Hesslocher Kuckuck emblem, with a small fairground, Kerbezelt, live music and the traditional Kerbebaum.

events.title: Gradierwerkfest Bad Orb
events.description: Bad Orb's festival around its historic 180-metre graduation tower (Gradierwerk) in the spa gardens: guided tours of the salt-graduation works, wellness and salt-product market, brass music, coffee and cake in the Kursaal.
events.location: Gradierwerk / Kurpark Bad Orb, 63619 Bad Orb

events.title: Stadtfest Dreieich
events.description: Dreieich's city festival in and around the historic Burg Hayn at Dreieichenhain, with market stalls, food trucks, live bands on two stages, a children's programme and evening fireworks over the castle moat.

events.title: NATUR PUR in der Hattenheimer Flur
events.description: The Hattenheim vintners (Eltville) set out a walking and tasting trail through their vineyards (3-4 October), from the Pfaffenberg to the Steinberg, with 16 estates pouring wines at stands along the marked route and regional food along the way.
events.location: Weingut Barth / Hattenheimer Flur, 65347 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: DenkmalKunst - KunstDenkmal Hann. Münden
events.description: A nine-day art trail (3-11 October) through Hann. Münden's half-timbered old town: commissioned and invited artists exhibit installations, sculpture and photography in historic houses, churches and the Werra Renaissance town hall.

events.title: Juse Ju - In jenen Tagen Tour
events.description: German rap with sharp social commentary: Juse Ju plays the Kulturzentrum Färberei in Kassel, touring the 'In jenen Tagen' record with a live band and his trademark blend of humour and political reflection.

events.title: Oktoberfest am Mainvorgelände Offenbach
events.description: Offenbach's Oktoberfest on the Mainvorgelände: Bavarian beer tent, live brass and party bands, Wiesn food and a full evening programme with entrance from 17:00. Dirndl and lederhosen welcome but not required.

events.title: Bauschemer Nachkerb
events.description: The follow-up weekend to Rüsselsheim-Bauschheim's Kerb (3-4 October), a smaller, cosier affair with the Kerbehalle, live music, home-made cakes and the traditional Kerbeborsch gathering.

events.title: 'Der Name der Rose' - Open-Air-Kino in der Basilika
events.description: Part of kinoSommer hessen: Umberto Eco's 'The Name of the Rose' is screened in the monumental basilica of Kloster Eberbach, where much of the film was shot. A rare cinema experience at the original location, including a short introduction.
events.location: Kloster Eberbach, Basilika, 65346 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Erntedankfest Fritzlar
events.description: Fritzlar's harvest-thanksgiving market in the cathedral and imperial city, with decorated harvest carts, regional produce, bread from the town's bakeries, church services and a parade through the medieval centre.

events.title: Heavysaurus - Metal Tour 2026/27
events.description: The world's leading 'dino metal' band for children rocks the Stadthalle Limburg: costumed dinosaurs playing ear-friendly heavy metal with a confetti and laser show, aimed at families with children from around four years up.
events.location: Stadthalle Limburg, Hospitalstr. 4, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Riesling Walk Schloss Vollrads
events.description: A guided walk around the Vollrads vineyards in Oestrich-Winkel with tasting stops among the Riesling vines, finishing at the Schloss for a glass and a view over the Rheingau. Around 6 km at a relaxed pace.

events.title: Apfelmarkt Wetzlar
events.description: Wetzlar's apple market in the old town celebrates the region's orchards with dozens of apple varieties, fresh juice and cider, apple pancakes, fruit trees for sale and pomology advice. Traditional market on the Eisenmarkt.

events.title: Glaskunst aus Nancy - Werke von Émile Gallé
events.description: A lecture and guided viewing of Art Nouveau glass by Émile Gallé and the Nancy school, drawing on the Gießen museum's decorative-arts holdings. Part of the city's regular art-history series.
events.location: Museum für Gießen / Altes Schloss, Brandplatz 2, 35390 Gießen

events.title: Badmómzjay - Haus im Meer Tour
events.description: One of Germany's most successful young rappers plays the Schlachthof Wiesbaden on her 'Haus im Meer' tour, presenting the more personal material of her 2026 album with full live band and stage production.

events.title: Schelmenmarkt Gelnhausen
events.description: Gelnhausen's four-day Volksfest (9-12 October) named after the town's trickster figure: a large Krammarkt through the medieval centre, funfair on the Untermarkt, beer tents and the Schelm parade on the Sunday.

events.title: Marburger Innenstadtkirmes
events.description: Marburg's city-centre fair (9-12 October): rides and showmen's stalls on the Rudolf-Bultmann-Straße and Gutenbergstraße fairground, Kerbezelt with live bands, Bratwurst stands and an evening fireworks show on the Saturday.

events.title: Sven Bensmann - SVENOMENAL
events.description: Comedy in the Erwin-Piscator-Haus Marburg: Sven Bensmann's 'SVENOMENAL' programme mixes observational humour, music and improvisation in a fast, interactive two-hour show.

events.title: Erntedankmarkt Bad Homburg
events.description: Bad Homburg's harvest market in the upper city centre (10-11 October), with Hessian farm produce, pumpkin and ornamental-gourd displays, rural craft, cider and a children's programme. Shops open on the Sunday.
events.location: Innenstadt Bad Homburg, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Idsteiner Herbstmarkt
events.description: A two-day autumn market (10-11 October) in Idstein's lovingly restored old town: arts and crafts, regional specialities, antiques, a small farm-animal enclosure and live music between the half-timbered houses.

events.title: Mittelalterlicher Markt Korbach
events.description: Korbach's medieval market (10-11 October) in the old town: historical traders, armourers and craftspeople, jugglers and minstrels, medieval food and drink, plus demonstrations of falconry and traditional crafts.

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt
events.description: A two-day market festival (10-11 October) around the Elisabethkirche and the Deutschordenshaus, with crafts, regional food, an artisan village, organ music in the church and guided tours of the Gothic Elisabethkirche.

events.title: Musik von Hans Zimmer - Lords of the Sound
events.description: A symphonic tribute to Hans Zimmer's film scores in Fulda's Esperantohalle, with a full orchestra and choir performing themes from Gladiator, Inception, Interstellar, The Lion King and Pirates of the Caribbean.

events.title: Robert Marc Lehmann: Mission Erde Live
events.description: The marine biologist and wildlife photographer presents his 'Mission Erde' live show in Marburg's Erwin-Piscator-Haus, mixing large-format photography, film sequences and first-hand reporting on ocean and rainforest conservation.

events.title: The Dark Tenor - Symphonica
events.description: Classical crossover in the Buderus Arena Wetzlar: The Dark Tenor (Billy Andrews) combines operatic vocals with rock band arrangements and dramatic staging, including material from 'Symphonica'.

events.title: Lullusfest Bad Hersfeld
events.description: Germany's oldest continuously recorded fair (first mentioned 852) runs 12-19 October through Bad Hersfeld's old town: a huge Krammarkt, funfair, festival hall, Lullus fire tradition and the Lullus procession with the Lullusfigur on 16 October.
events.location: Innenstadt / Stiftsruine Bad Hersfeld, 36251 Bad Hersfeld

events.title: Lulluskrammarkt Bad Hersfeld
events.description: The main market day of the Lullusfest: around 250 travelling traders fill Bad Hersfeld's streets with textiles, household goods, sweets, baskets and spices - the classic Krammarkt of one of Germany's oldest fairs.

events.title: Maite Itoiz & John Kelly - Best of 20 Years
events.description: The Spanish-Irish duo celebrates two decades of collaboration in the Stadthallen Wetzlar, blending Celtic, classical and flamenco elements with their own compositions and vocal pieces.

events.title: Deutscher Straßen- und Verkehrskongress 2026
events.description: Germany's central road and transport congress (14-16 October) at the RheinMain CongressCenter, with technical lectures, seminars and a large exhibition of road-building, traffic-technology and infrastructure suppliers.

events.title: Das Kriminal Dinner - Louvre
events.description: A murder-mystery dinner in the Weißer Saal of Schloss Philippsruhe Hanau: actors play suspects between courses while guests solve the case, with a four-course menu included in the ticket price.
events.location: Schloss Philippsruhe, Weißer Saal, Philippsruher Allee 45, 63454 Hanau

events.title: Gallusmarkt Wetzlar
events.description: Wetzlar's historic Gallusmarkt (15-18 October), documented since the 14th century: a large Krammarkt through the old town and an extensive funfair, with a beer tent, live music and the traditional market opening.

events.title: Escape-Dinner: Knack den Geschmack
events.description: An escape-room-meets-dinner event in Fulda's Propstei Johannesberg: teams of guests solve puzzles between courses to unlock the menu, combining a multi-course dinner with a live puzzle game.

events.title: Waldauer Enten-Kirmes
events.description: Kassel-Waldau's parish fair (16-19 October), famous for its wooden duck-lottery stands alongside a small funfair, Kerbezelt with live music, and the Sunday Kirmes parade through the quarter.

events.title: Oktoberfest Limburg
events.description: Limburg's Oktoberfest on the Festplatz (mid-October, running to about 20 October): a big Bavarian beer tent with brass and party bands, Wiesn food, a midday Wiesn afternoon and evening party sessions.
events.location: Festplatz Limburg, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Tabaluga und Lilli - Das Musical
events.description: Peter Maffay's popular children's musical staged in the Stadthallen Wetzlar, with the dragon Tabaluga, large puppets, songs from the albums and a family-friendly running time of around two hours.

events.title: Jassin - Die größere Arsenalplatz Tour
events.description: The East German rapper plays the Schlachthof Wiesbaden: songs about origin, class and society from 'Arsenalplatz' and its successor, delivered with a live band and a loyal, vocal audience.

events.title: Eure Mütter: Best Of Jubiläum
events.description: The Hessian comedian trio celebrates its anniversary with a best-of programme in the Stadthalle Baunatal, mixing sketch, music and improv from two decades of touring.

events.title: Tito & Tarantula - Best Of Tour 2026
events.description: The band behind 'After Dark' from From Dusk Till Dawn brings its Latin-tinged desert rock to the Kulturzentrum Kreuz Fulda on a best-of tour.

events.title: Nights on Broadway - Tribute
events.description: A musical-theatre gala in Fulda's Esperantohalle: soloists and orchestra perform songs from The Lion King, Phantom of the Opera, Les Misérables, Mamma Mia and other Broadway and West End hits.

events.title: One Night of Dire Straits
events.description: A full-band tribute to Dire Straits in the Kongresshalle Gießen, recreating the Brothers in Arms-era sound with authentic guitar work and stage lighting.

events.title: Herbstmarkt Hofgeismar
events.description: Hofgeismar's autumn market in the historic town centre: market stalls, harvest produce, sugar-bread and gingerbread stands, plus a small fairground on the Marktplatz. Family afternoon with brass music.

events.title: Yasi Hofer
events.description: The young German electric guitarist - known from the German TV talent show and touring with Helene Fischer - plays an intimate club show at the Theaterstübchen in Kassel, blending rock, funk and pop instrumentals.

events.title: Herbstfest mit Handwerkermarkt Lorsch
events.description: Lorsch's autumn festival and craft market in front of the UNESCO-listed abbey gatehouse, with potters, basket-weavers, felt and wood craftspeople demonstrating and selling, plus pumpkin soup, Federweißer and live folk music.

events.title: Ein Abend mit Robert Kreis
events.description: The celebrated Berlin cabaret entertainer, singer and pianist brings his Weimar-era repertoire of chansons, jokes and piano virtuosity to the Rheingauer Wein Bühne in Oestrich-Winkel.

events.title: ABBA - Tribute Night auf Burg Gleiberg
events.description: An ABBA tribute concert inside the medieval walls of Burg Gleiberg above Wettenberg, with a live band in period costume, a bar in the castle courtyard and views over the Lahn valley.

events.title: STAFFINGpro - HR Services & Staffing Industry Expo
events.description: A trade expo at the RheinMain CongressCenter for staffing firms and HR service providers, with supplier stands, workshops on recruitment technology and compliance sessions. Trade visitors only.

events.title: Jan Philipp Zymny - Straßentherapie
events.description: Poetry-slam champion turned comedian Jan Philipp Zymny brings his 'Straßentherapie' show to the Stadthalle Baunatal: rapid-fire wordplay, absurd observation and audience interaction.

events.title: Kasseler Musiktage 2026
events.description: Kassel's long-running music festival (22 October - 1 November) explores musical movement across chamber, orchestral and choral programmes in the city's museums, churches and concert halls. Opening concert: Treppenhausorchester with purely acoustic beats and melodies.
events.cost_per_person: Tickets from ~20 EUR, festival pass available
events.location: Various venues incl. Kongress Palais, 34117 Kassel

events.title: European Youth Circus 2026
events.description: Europe's leading youth circus competition pitches its big top on the Dernsches Gelände in Wiesbaden (22-25 October): two competition shows daily, a gala show with prize-giving on 24 October and an ecumenical service plus second gala on the 25th. Around 150 young artists from a dozen countries.
events.cost_per_person: Tickets from ~15 EUR, family tickets available

events.title: AzubiTECH 2026
events.description: An expo on training technology and innovation at the RheinMain CongressCenter, aimed at trainers, vocational schools and HR teams, with live demonstrations of digital learning tools.

events.title: Reitsportmesse Gießen
events.description: An equestrian trade fair (23-25 October) at the Gießen Messe grounds: saddlery, riding equipment, stable technology, feed suppliers and daily live riding demonstrations and shows in the indoor arena.
events.location: Messe Gießen, An der Hessenhalle 1, 35398 Gießen

events.title: Das Kriminal Dinner - Der letzte Joint
events.description: A murder-mystery dinner at the Waldgaststätte Hohes Gras above Kassel: actors perform between courses while guests interrogate the case, with a multi-course menu and forest views over the Habichtswald.

events.title: 'Die Blauen Reiterinnen' - Sonderausstellung
events.description: The Museum Wiesbaden's 2026 highlight exhibition (23 October 2026 - 21 February 2027) examines the influence of well-known and forgotten women artists in the circle of Der Blaue Reiter, with works by Marianne von Werefkin, Gabriele Münter and others.

events.title: Butzbacher Katharinenmarkt
events.description: Butzbach's Katharinenmarkt (24-27 October) is one of the Wetterau's oldest fairs: Krammarkt through the walled old town, funfair on the Festplatz, beer tent with live bands and the traditional market opening with the mayor.

events.title: 760. Kalter Markt Ortenberg
events.description: One of Hessen's oldest fairs, held since 1266 (23-27 October) in Ortenberg's Wetterau old town: a large Krammarkt through the streets, funfair, market hall with regional produce and the traditional Kalter-Markt opening ceremony.

events.title: Vinyl Night Smooth Jazz im Loftwerk
events.description: A monthly vinyl session in the WERKLOFT at Wiesbaden's Loftwerk: DJs work through jazz, soul and house from the turntable, with cocktails and a relaxed late-night crowd. Every fourth Saturday of the month.

events.title: Alsfelder Schokoladenmarkt
events.description: Alsfeld's chocolate market transforms the half-timbered old town into a giant confectioner's shop: artisan chocolatiers, praline tastings, chocolate sculptures, hot chocolate and a children's chocolate workshop.

events.title: WAHNSINN! Die Show
events.description: A large-scale entertainment and variety show in the Esperantohalle Fulda: comedy acts, magic, acrobatics, live music and audience participation hosted by a touring ensemble.

events.title: FISCH & WEIN mit Gastkoch Jörg Hansen
events.description: Guest chef Jörg Hansen of Cuxhaven's Hotel Seelust - winner of the Goldene Kochmütze and Koch des Jahres - cooks a fish menu at Weingut Sohns in Geisenheim, matched with the estate's Rieslings.

events.title: PETER KUNZ - HESSKALATION
events.description: Hessian stand-up comedian Peter Kunz brings his 'HESSkalation' programme to the Rheingauer Wein Bühne, with dialect humour, sharp observations on apple wine and regional identity, and plenty of audience banter.

events.title: Oarhelljer Kerb Darmstadt-Arheilgen
events.description: Darmstadt-Arheilgen's parish fair (29 October - 3 November), one of the region's biggest Kerben, with a large fairground, Kerbehalle, live music and the traditional Kerbeumzug with the Kerbeborsch on the first Sunday.

events.title: Casseler Herbst-Freyheit
events.description: Kassel's city festival in the pedestrian zone (29 October - 1 November): market and craft stands, food, live music on several stages, an autumn fairground on Friedrichsplatz and a late-season shopping Sunday.

events.title: Kappeskerb und Weinlesefest Eltville
events.description: A combined cabbage fair and grape-harvest festival in Eltville (30 October - 2 November): sauerkraut and Kappes specialities, Federweißer and new wine, brass music, and a small funfair on the Rheinufer.
events.location: Rheinufer / Altstadt Eltville, 65343 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Kulturnacht Bad Homburg
events.description: Bad Homburg's culture night: museums, galleries, churches, the Kurhaus and the Schloss open late with short performances, installations, readings and music, linked by a shuttle bus and a wristband ticket.
events.location: Various venues, Innenstadt Bad Homburg, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Kunsthandwerkermarkt in der documenta-Halle
events.description: A curated applied-arts market in Kassel's documenta-Halle (31 October - 1 November): around 80 selected makers present ceramics, jewellery, textiles, glassware and woodwork, with demonstrations and a café.

events.title: Martinifest Nidda
events.description: Nidda's Martinifest (31 October - 1 November) in the Wetterau old town with lantern-lit streets, a lantern parade for children, market stalls, Martin's goose dishes and live music around the Marktplatz.

events.title: Schlitzer Runkelrübenfest
events.description: Schlitz's unusual beetroot festival in the Vogelsberg old town: beetroot dishes both sweet and savoury, beetroot wine and schnapps, a sugar-beet weighing contest, market stalls and live music.

events.title: Liebigs Suppenfest
events.description: Gießen's soup festival in honour of Justus von Liebig: local restaurants, clubs and the university serve around 30 soups from stalls in the city centre, with a jury prize and a public vote. Family-friendly and inexpensive.

events.title: Matinée musicale der Hempelstiftung (November)
events.description: The second autumn matinée of the Wiesbaden Hempelstiftung, again in the Loge Plato on Friedrichstraße, presenting young scholarship holders in a mixed programme of chamber music.
events.location: Loge Plato, Großer Saal, Friedrichstraße 35, 65185 Wiesbaden

events.title: Stefanie Heinzmann - Circles Tour 2026
events.description: The Swiss soul-pop singer and winner of the German talent show 'SSDSDSSWEMUGABRTLAD' plays the Stadthalle Baunatal on her 'Circles' tour, with a live band and songs from her latest album plus her best-known hits.

events.title: Wintergold Markt Hanau
events.description: Hanau's winter and Christmas market village (4 November - 22 December) in the city centre: wooden huts with craftsmanship, mulled drinks, a covered food court, ice rink and a light installation programme on the Marktplatz.

events.title: Clemens Brock - Der Vadda
events.description: Comedy in the Stadthalle Offenbach: Clemens Brock's 'Der Vadda' programme looks at the absurdities of parenthood, family life and middle age with fast-paced storytelling.
events.location: Stadthalle Offenbach, Berliner Str. 2, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Rock The Circus
events.description: Circus and rock music collide in the Parktheater Bensheim: acrobats, aerial artists and hand-to-hand performers are accompanied live by an electric rock band. A full-evening family and adult show.

events.title: Yakari - Freunde fürs Leben
events.description: A stage adaptation of the classic children's comic in the Congress Park Hanau: the little Sioux Yakari and his horse Little Thunder in a colourful family musical with songs, puppets and video scenery.

events.title: Moving Shadows: On Fire
events.description: A shadow-dance and multimedia show in the Stadthallen Wetzlar: performers work with light, projection and body art to tell a story of fire and transformation, set to live percussion.

events.title: Martin Rütter - SCHLUSS! AUS!
events.description: Germany's best-known dog trainer brings his new live programme to the Kurhaus Wiesbaden, mixing practical dog-training insight with comedy and film from his television work.

events.title: Martinimarkt Bad Schwalbach
events.description: Bad Schwalbach's Martinimarkt (6-10 November): a traditional Krammarkt through the spa town's centre with a funfair, sweet stalls, market hall and live music, held since the 18th century.

events.title: Hochheimer Markt
events.description: One of the largest and oldest Volksfeste in the Rhine-Main region, held annually in the weekend after All Souls (6-10 November, 2026) in Hochheim: a five-day mix of funfair, cattle market, trade fair and Krammarkt across seven hectares, with an opening ceremony and five cannon shots on Friday at noon and a closing fireworks display.

events.title: Kalter Markt Schlüchtern
events.description: Schlüchtern's historic Kalter Markt (6-10 November), an old autumn fair in the Kinzig valley with a large Krammarkt through the old town, funfair, cattle show and market hall with regional produce.

events.title: Viernheimer Kerwe
events.description: Viernheim's town fair (6-11 November) in the Bergstraße municipality: a fairground in the city centre, Kerwe hall with live bands, wine and beer stands, and the traditional Kerweumzug on the Sunday.

events.title: Bodo Wartke - Wunderpunkt
events.description: The piano cabaret artist plays the Stadthallen Wetzlar with 'Wunderpunkt': witty German-language songs, wordplay and political satire at the grand piano.

events.title: Massenheimer Kerb
events.description: Bad Vilbel-Massenheim's parish fair (7-9 November) with rides, Kerbezelt, apple wine and the Massenheimer Kerbepaar. Sunday service and Kerbeumzug through the village.

events.title: GameChanger by Bastian Bielendorfer
events.description: The comedian and podcaster brings his 'GameChanger' show to the Stadthalle Baunatal: stories from school, gaming, family and the absurdities of adult life.

events.title: Puppen- und Bären Festtage Eschwege
events.description: Eschwege's doll and teddy-bear days (7-8 November) in the town centre: collectors' stands, antique dolls and bears, restoration workshops, puppet theatre for children and a doll-doctors' consultation corner.

events.title: William Wahl - wahlweise
events.description: The former 'Basta' vocal acrobat performs solo in the Kongresshalle Gießen: a cappella loops, quirky German songs and dry humour.

events.title: Das Kriminal Dinner im Schlosshotel Weilburg
events.description: A murder-mystery dinner in the baroque Schlosshotel Weilburg above the Lahn: professional actors play the suspects between the courses of a multi-course menu.

events.title: Gentleman - Gratitude Tour 2026
events.description: Germany's best-known reggae artist plays the Schlachthof Wiesbaden on his 'Gratitude' tour, with a full band performing roots reggae, dancehall and his classic hits.

events.title: Riesling Gala im Kloster Eberbach (Glorreiche Rheingau Tage)
events.description: The crowning finale of the Glorreichen Rheingau Tage: 500 guests sit at one long table in the Laiendormitorium of Kloster Eberbach for a full-day gala menu, with the Rheingau VDP estates pouring matching Rieslings. Nearly 40 years of tradition.
events.location: Kloster Eberbach, Laiendormitorium, 65346 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Nights on Broadway - Tribute (Kassel)
events.description: A musical-theatre gala in the Probonio Arena Kassel with soloists and orchestra performing Broadway and West End repertoire from Phantom, Les Misérables, Wicked and The Lion King.

events.title: St. Martins-Umzug Lorsch
events.description: Lorsch's St Martin's lantern procession through the old town, with hand-made lanterns, brass band, a rider as St Martin on horseback and the traditional sharing of the cloak in front of the Kloster. Mulled drinks and Martin's pastries afterwards.

events.title: Martinimarkt Weilmünster
events.description: Weilmünster's traditional Martinimarkt in the Weil valley: market stalls through the town centre, autumn produce, a funfair and later a St Martin's lantern parade for children.

events.title: Herr Schröder
events.description: The award-winning German teacher-comedian performs his schoolroom satire in the Stadthallen Wetzlar, with an interactive 'lesson' format and plenty of audience participation.

events.title: Veljanov - Solo
events.description: Alexander Veljanov, frontman of Deine Lakaien, plays a solo show at the Schlachthof Wiesbaden: dark-wave ballads, art song and material from his solo albums with piano and string accompaniment.

events.title: Sankt Martinsumzug Michelstadt
events.description: Michelstadt's St Martin's procession through the Odenwald old town, with lanterns, a brass band and a rider portraying St Martin at the Marktbrunnen. Warm drinks and Martinsbrezeln on the market square afterwards.

events.title: Maxi Gstettenbauer - KOMPLETT ABSURD
events.description: Stand-up comedy in the KUZ Kreuz Fulda: Maxi Gstettenbauer's 'KOMPLETT ABSURD' programme about everyday chaos, technology and the absurdity of modern life.

events.title: Martinsumzug Gelnhausen
events.description: Gelnhausen's St Martin's lantern procession through the medieval old town, led by a rider on horseback, with brass band, lanterns made in the town's schools and kindergartens, and Martinsbrezeln at the Obermarkt.

events.title: Rheingauer Krimiabend: Birgit Körner im Weingut Georg Breuer
events.description: Part of the 12th season of the Rheingauer Krimiabende held every Wednesday in November: Birgit Körner reads a local crime story in the Rüdesheim cellars of Weingut Georg Breuer, with wines poured alongside. Motto: 'Das Blut tropft - der Wein fließt'.
events.location: Weingut Georg Breuer, Rüdesheim am Rhein, 65385 Rüdesheim am Rhein

events.title: Cecile Verny & Johannes Maikranz
events.description: The jazz singer with West African roots and the guitarist Johannes Maikranz interpret German art song and cabaret repertoire - from Knef and Zarah Leander to Schubert - in the Kultur- und Tagungshaus Rauenthal.
events.location: Kultur- und Tagungshaus Rauenthal, 65345 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Matze Knop - Spitzenreiter
events.description: The German comedian and impressionist brings 'Spitzenreiter' to the Kongresshalle Gießen, with voices and impressions of German football and showbiz figures alongside his own songs.

events.title: NightWash Live
events.description: The live touring version of the cult TV comedy show, recorded in the Stadthalle Baunatal: a line-up of stand-up comedians with a host, performed in the round.

events.title: Martinsgans - Weiß- oder Rotwein?
events.description: A five-course St Martin's goose dinner at Weingut Craß in Erbach with ten matched wines and sparkling wines, hosted with a wine commentary, welcome Sekt, water and espresso included.
events.location: Weingut Craß, Erbach, 65346 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Prison Break vs. Reality
events.description: A true-crime live talk at the Propstei Johannesberg Fulda: former investigators and journalists compare Hollywood prison-break fiction with real cases, with original footage and audience questions.

events.title: Martinsgans-Menü im Weingut Sohns
events.description: A seasonal three-course St Martin's goose menu at Weingut Sohns in Geisenheim, with red cabbage, braised apple, chestnuts and dumplings, matched to the estate's wines. A vegetarian alternative is offered.

events.title: Hofheimer Eiszauber
events.description: Hofheim's winter ice rink and winter village (13 November - 10 January) on the Kellereiplatz: open-air ice skating under floodlights, curling lanes, Alpine huts with mulled drinks and a small programme for children.
events.cost_per_person: Ice-rink ticket from ~7 EUR incl. skates

events.title: Lichterzauber in Lorsch
events.description: Lorsch's old town is illuminated for one evening with light installations, lanterns and projections on the UNESCO-listed abbey complex, accompanied by street food, live music and late-opening shops.

events.title: exground filmfest 39
events.description: Wiesbaden's international festival of short and independent film (13-22 November) screens some 200 productions from around the world at the Caligari FilmBühne and other venues, with competitions, retrospectives and filmmaker Q&As.
events.cost_per_person: Single tickets from ~9 EUR, festival pass available

events.title: Mamma Mia - ABBA Konzerttour
events.description: A full ABBA show with live band and vocalists in the S-Club Fulda, performing the complete greatest hits including Mamma Mia, Dancing Queen and Waterloo, with period costume.

events.title: Sekttage im Wein- und Sektgut F.B. Schönleber
events.description: Nine days of sparkling-wine events (14-22 November) at F.B. Schönleber in Mittelheim: cellar tours, riddling (Rüttel) demonstrations, Sekt seminars and tastings across the range of Rheingau Sekt.
events.location: Wein- und Sektgut F.B. Schönleber, Mittelheim, 65375 Oestrich-Winkel

events.title: Klang - Geschichten - Raum
events.description: A matinée for families in Wiesbaden's Stadt- und Musikbibliothek with the Theater 3D: sound stories, instruments to try and short scenes built around listening and space, aimed at children and their adults.

events.title: Themenführung 'Der Name der Rose' im Kloster Eberbach
events.description: A guided tour linking the history of Kloster Eberbach with the shooting of 'The Name of the Rose': original props and film locations in the basilica and monk's dormitory, plus a welcome glass of Rheingau wine.

events.title: Family Day im Museum
events.description: A hands-on family afternoon at the Museum für Gießen: short guided tours for children, craft stations, a treasure hunt through the collections and a chance to handle original objects with curators.
events.cost_per_person: Free for children, reduced adult ticket

events.title: LARS REICHOW: BOOMERLAND
events.description: The Mainz-born cabaret artist takes on the baby-boomer generation in 'BOOMERLAND' at the Rheingauer Wein Bühne: piano, wordplay and pointed social commentary.

events.title: Judit Reigl. Couleur vivante. - Ausstellung
events.description: The Museum Reinhard Ernst opens a major survey of the Hungarian-French painter Judit Reigl (15 November 2026 - April 2027), tracing her abstract 'Couleur vivante' period and its links to the first post-war exhibition of French and German informal painting in Wiesbaden in 1957.

events.title: Darmstädter Weihnachtsmarkt
events.description: Darmstadt's Christmas market (16 November - 23 December) spreads across the Marktplatz, Friedensplatz and the Schloss area with around 100 wooden huts, a giant Christmas tree, an ice rink, artisan crafts and a daily stage programme.

events.title: Santiano - Die große Arena Tour 2026
events.description: Germany's leading shanty-rock band plays the Probonio Arena Kassel on their arena tour, with a large stage set, nautical staging and singalong hits from their albums.

events.title: Offenbacher Weihnachtsmarkt
events.description: Offenbach's Christmas market (16 November - 29 December) on the Marktplatz and Wilhelmsplatz: wooden huts with crafts and food, a Christmas pyramid, children's carousel and a live programme of choirs and bands.

events.title: Herbstmarkt Bad Hersfeld
events.description: Bad Hersfeld's late-autumn market in the old town: Krammarkt stalls with textiles, household goods and regional food, plus a funfair on the Hattorfer Straße. Held in the tradition of the Lullus market days.

events.title: Rheingauer Krimiabend: Carola Christiansen bei den Winzern von Erbach
events.description: Another Wednesday evening in the Rheingauer Krimiabende series: Carola Christiansen reads a crime story among the vintners of Erbach, with Rheingau wines served through the evening.
events.location: Bachmanns Wein + Kultur / Winzer von Erbach, 65346 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: SALÒ - Hardcore Ist Tot Tour 2026
events.description: The German rap duo plays the Kulturkeller Fulda, touring the 'Hardcore Ist Tot' record with their characteristic blend of punk energy and hip-hop.

events.title: Weihnachtsstadt Bad Homburg (Winterzauber & Eiswinter)
events.description: Bad Homburg's Christmas town (19 November - 31 December): the Winterzauber market on the Schlossplatz with an ice rink and curling, the 'Eiswinter' sculpture exhibition in the Kurpark, illumination of the Schloss and a daily Advent programme.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry, ice rink from ~7 EUR
events.location: Schlossplatz / Kurpark Bad Homburg, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Weihnachtsmarkt der Nationen Rüdesheim
events.description: Rüdesheim's international Christmas market (19 November - 23 December) turns the narrow alleys of the old town into a romantic Christmas village, with stands from around 20 nations, an Advent calendar window on the town hall and a nativity scene on the market square.

events.title: Jahreskonzert der Wiesbadener Musik- & Kunstschule
events.description: The annual concert of the Wiesbadener Musik- & Kunstschule e.V. in the Kulturforum Friedrichstraße: ensembles and soloists from all departments perform highlights from the year's work.

events.title: Mirja Boes & die HonkeyDonkeys
events.description: Comedy and live music in the Stadthalle Baunatal: Mirja Boes performs her new programme with her band, blending stand-up, songs and improvisation.

events.title: FRIDAY BEATS - Masurka
events.description: Live music night in the WERKLOFT of Wiesbaden's Loftwerk: regional acts start the weekend, with Masurka - a versatile newcomer from Heidelberg - moving between R&B, soul, hip-hop, drum & bass and EDM. Drinks and DJ set afterwards.

events.title: Öffentliche Glühweinführung Kloster Eberbach
events.description: A winter guided tour of the Kloster Eberbach cloister with warm clothing and a glass of Glühwein: the Cistercian order, the abbey's economy and its wine history told through the roman-gothic ensemble.

events.title: Serdar Somuncu - HASSIAS
events.description: The writer, satirist and actor performs 'HASSIAS' in the Orangerie of the Maritim Hotel Fulda: a biting, high-tempo reckoning with German society and the phenomenon of hatred.
events.location: Orangerie, Maritim Hotel Fulda, Paxtonplatz 1, 36037 Fulda

events.title: CONNY & Liser - Ælpha Male Club Tour 2026
events.description: Hip-hop in the Kulturzentrum Färberei Kassel: the duo CONNY & Liser perform their 'Ælpha Male Club Tour' set in an intimate club setting with support act.

events.title: Konzert zum Instrument des Jahres: Akkordeon
events.description: A concert in the Stadt- und Musikbibliothek Wiesbaden celebrating the accordion as Instrument of the Year, with solo and ensemble performances spanning tango, musette and contemporary repertoire.

events.title: Loriot - live auf der Bühne
events.description: A staged homage to Loriot in the Esperantohalle Fulda: actors perform his best-known sketches - the potato, the noodle, the Advent poem - as live theatre, with original archive footage between scenes.

events.title: The Music of Queen Live
events.description: A symphonic rock tribute in the Esperantohalle Fulda: a full band with orchestra performs Queen's catalogue, from Bohemian Rhapsody to We Will Rock You, with video staging.

events.title: GERDA & WALTER: Do sin se widder!
events.description: The cult Hessian comedy duo returns with 'Noch mehr Kabbeleien' at the Rheingauer Wein Bühne: dialect sketches, songs and marital bickering in a warm, very Hessian evening.
